name: Approved Investment Project Residence Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Law No. 9 of 2010 on Promoting Investment: an approved investment project is issued through a single-window service (one authority handles all licenses and approvals, superseding the need for others). Approved foreign investors receive residence visas renewable for 5 years, tied to the project's duration, plus multiple exit/re-entry visas. Expatriate employees of the project may transfer salaries abroad and are exempt from customs duties on personal effects. The law itself sets NO minimum capital threshold -- it delegates that figure to an Executive Regulation, which this dataset could not locate or fetch.
requirements.fix_path: Have an investment project approved under Law 9/2010's single-window licensing process (no minimum capital confirmed in the law's own text) to receive the 5-year renewable residence visa.

outcome.duration_length: 5 years, renewable, tied to the project's duration

sources.title: UNCTAD Investment Policy Hub (intergovernmental organization) -- Libya's Law No. 9 of 2010 on Promoting Investment: single-window licensing, 5-year renewable residence visa for approved investors, no stated minimum capital

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Libya). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier 2 (UNCTAD, an intergovernmental organization hosting an authoritative English translation, not a .gov.ly domain). GENUINE, POSITIVE FINDING that stands apart from Bolivia/Angola/Cameroon/Congo-Brazzaville's investor routes: Libya's investment law explicitly grants a confirmed, numeric residence benefit (5-year renewable visa tied to project duration) directly in the primary legal text, rather than leaving residency entirely unaddressed. The capital-threshold absence (delegated to an unlocated Executive Regulation) matches the disclosed-absence pattern found in every other country's investor route built this session.
